basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old living in Boston, an avid fan of the New England Patriots and Post Malone. By day, I work as a software engineer, and by night, I dive into Madden Ultimate Team and the latest hip-hop beats. I enjoy discussing team strategies and album drops while sipping on a craft IPA. Not a big fan of early mornings, so I’m usually online late into the night. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to pursue my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been a lifelong gamer. My passion for Madden started in college when a friend introduced me to Ultimate Team. I've also been a music enthusiast since my teenage years, keeping up with industry news and trends online.
